title: farm gui
features: Auto kill any npc / auto farm chest / auto open chest - lootbag / auto picking up drop from boss/mini boss (PICK ONLY LOOTBAG AND DIAMOND CHEST)
script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local chestEnabled = false
local chestRunning = false
local npcKillEnabled = false
local autoOpenEnabled = false
local lootVacuumEnabled = false

local CHECK_DELAY = 0.4
local MAX_CHESTS = 8
local skippedPrompts = {}
local selectedChestTypes = {} 
local selectedNPCTypes = {} 
local selectedOpenTypes = {} 
local chestCache = {}

local function checkIgnore(instance)
	if not instance then return false end
	local nameLower = string.lower(instance.Name)
	if nameLower:find("world") or nameLower:find("omnius") or nameLower:find("witch") or nameLower:find("merchant") then return true end
	local current = instance.Parent
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		local pName = string.lower(current.Name)
		if pName:find("world") or pName:find("omnius") or pName:find("witch") or pName:find("merchant") then return true end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return false
end

local function isChest(instance)
	if not instance then return false end
	local nameLower = string.lower(instance.Name)
	return (instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("BasePart")) and (nameLower:find("chest") or nameLower:find("diamond")) and not checkIgnore(instance)
end

local function refreshChestCache()
	table.clear(chestCache)
	for _, prompt in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and prompt.Parent and isChest(prompt.Parent) then
			table.insert(chestCache, prompt)
		end
	end
end

local function getPos(prompt)
	local parent = prompt.Parent if not parent then return end
	if parent:IsA("Attachment") then return parent.WorldPosition end
	if parent:IsA("BasePart") then return parent.Position end
	if parent:IsA("Model") then return parent:GetPivot().Position end
end

local function getChests(root)
	local list, hasSelection = {}, false
	for _, v in pairs(selectedChestTypes) do if v then hasSelection = true break end end
	for _, prompt in ipairs(chestCache) do
		if prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and not skippedPrompts[prompt] then
			if not hasSelection or selectedChestTypes[prompt.Parent.Name] then
				local pos = getPos(prompt)
				if pos then table.insert(list, {prompt = prompt, pos = pos, dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude}) end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
	return {unpack(list, 1, math.min(#list, MAX_CHESTS))}
end

local function collectLoop()
	if chestRunning then return end chestRunning = true
	while chestEnabled do
		task.wait(CHECK_DELAY)
		local character = player.Character 
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") 
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root then
			refreshChestCache()
			local targets = getChests(root)
			
			if #targets > 0 then
				local originalCFrame = root.CFrame
				local savedCollides = {}
				for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do 
					if part:IsA("BasePart") then savedCollides[part] = part.CanCollide part.CanCollide = false end 
				end
				for _, data in ipairs(targets) do
					if not chestEnabled then break end
					local prompt, pos = data.prompt, data.pos
					if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and pos then
						root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos + Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 1.2), pos)
						if workspace.CurrentCamera then workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, pos) end
						task.wait(0.18)
						if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then
							local keyCode = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode or Enum.KeyCode.E
							pcall(function() 
								VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyCode, false, game) 
								task.wait(prompt.HoldDuration > 0 and prompt.HoldDuration + 0.05 or 0.02) 
								VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyCode, false, game) 
							end)
							if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then 
								pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldBegin() task.wait(math.max(prompt.HoldDuration, 0.02)) prompt:InputHoldEnd() end) 
							end
							local start = os.clock()
							while prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled and os.clock() - start < 0.35 do task.wait(0.02) end
							if prompt.Parent and prompt.Enabled then skippedPrompts[prompt] = true end
						end
						task.wait(0.03)
					end
				end
				for part, col in pairs(savedCollides) do if part and part.Parent then part.CanCollide = col end end
				if root and root.Parent then root.CFrame = originalCFrame end
			else
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end
	end
	chestRunning = false
end

local function lootVacuumLoop()
	while lootVacuumEnabled do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		
		if root then
			local workspaceChildren = workspace:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #workspaceChildren do
				if not lootVacuumEnabled then break end
				local item = workspaceChildren[i]
				local nameLower = string.lower(item.Name)
				
				if nameLower:find("lootbag") or 
				   nameLower:find("elder") or 
				   nameLower:find("diamond") or 
				   nameLower:find("darkness") or 
				   (nameLower:find("chest") and not item:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")) then
					pcall(function()
						if item:IsA("BasePart") and not item.Anchored then
							item.CFrame = root.CFrame
						elseif item:IsA("Model") then
							item:PivotTo(root.CFrame)
						end
						local prompt = item:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
						if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
							fireproximityprompt(prompt)
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.15)
	end
end

local function openInventoryLoop()
	while autoOpenEnabled do
		local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		
		if backpack and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			local hasOpenSelection = false
			for _, v in pairs(selectedOpenTypes) do if v then hasOpenSelection = true break end end
			
			local openedThisFrame = 0
			local maxPerFrame = 15
			
			local backpackTools = backpack:GetChildren()
			for i = 1, #backpackTools do
				if openedThisFrame >= maxPerFrame or not autoOpenEnabled then break end
				local tool = backpackTools[i]
				if tool:IsA("Tool") then
					local toolName = string.lower(tool.Name)
					if not hasOpenSelection or selectedOpenTypes[tool.Name] then
						if toolName:find("chest") or toolName:find("diamond") or toolName:find("darkness") then
							openedThisFrame = openedThisFrame + 1
							task.spawn(function()
								pcall(function()
									if tool:FindFirstChild("OpenAll") then
										tool.OpenAll:FireServer()
									elseif tool:FindFirstChild("Open") then
										tool.Open:FireServer(true)
									else
										humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
										tool:Activate()
									end
								end)
							end)
						elseif toolName:find("lootbag") then
							openedThisFrame = openedThisFrame + 1
							for j = 1, 5 do
								task.spawn(function()
									pcall(function()
										humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
										tool:Activate()
									end)
								end)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
	end
end

local function npcKillLoop()
	while npcKillEnabled do
		local character = player.Character
		
		pcall(function()
			sethiddenproperty(player, "SimulationRadius", 112412400000)
			sethiddenproperty(player, "MaxSimulationRadius", 112412400000)
		end)

		local hasNpcSelection = false
		for npcName, selected in pairs(selectedNPCTypes) do
			if selected == true then hasNpcSelection = true break end
		end

		local allObjects = workspace:GetDescendants()
		for i = 1, #allObjects do
			local d = allObjects[i]
			if d and d:IsA("Humanoid") and d.Parent and d.Parent ~= character and not checkIgnore(d.Parent) then
				if not hasNpcSelection or selectedNPCTypes[d.Parent.Name] == true then
					if d.Health > 0 then
						pcall(function()
							d.Health = 0
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		task.wait(0.3) 
	end
end

gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn = "ChestCollectorPremiumMenu", false

local panel = Instance.new("Frame", gui) 
panel.Size, panel.Position, panel.BackgroundColor3, panel.BorderSizePixel, panel.Active = UDim2.fromOffset(640, 410), UDim2.new(0.5, -320, 0.3, 0), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26), 0, true
Instance.new("UICorner", panel).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

	Instance.new("UICorner", button).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8) 
	return button
end

title.Size, title.Position, title.BackgroundTransparency, title.Text, title.TextColor3, title.Font, title.TextSize, title.TextXAlignment = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 40), UDim2.fromOffset(16, 0), 1, "ULTIMATE PREMIUM HUB v7", Color3.fromRGB(190, 180, 255), Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 16, 0

local vacuumToggle = makeButton("Loot Vacuum: OFF", UDim2.fromOffset(145, 42), UDim2.fromOffset(326, 50), panel, Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65))

local exT = Instance.new("TextLabel", panel)
exT.Size, exT.Position, exT.BackgroundTransparency, exT.Text, exT.TextColor3, exT.Font, exT.TextSize, exT.TextXAlignment = UDim2.fromOffset(165, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(12, 115), 1, "CHEST FILTER", Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 150), Enum.Font.GothamBold, 11, 0
local refChest = makeButton("↻", UDim2.fromOffset(24, 20), UDim2.fromOffset(183, 115), panel, Color3.fromRGB(35, 150, 60)) refChest.TextSize = 12

-- Open Menu Button
local reo = makeButton("Open Menu", UDim2.fromOffset(140, 40), UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.8, 0), gui, Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)) reo.Visible = false Instance.new("UIStroke", reo).Color = Color3.fromRGB(75, 70, 105)
-- List Updates Functions
local function updateChestList()
for _, child in ipairs(scr:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
refreshChestCache()
local chestNames = {} for _, prompt in ipairs(chestCache) do if prompt.Parent then chestNames[prompt.Parent.Name] = true end end
for name, _ in pairs(chestNames) do
local cb = Instance.new("TextButton", scr)
cb.Size, cb.Font, cb.TextSize, cb.Text, cb.TextXAlignment, cb.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 32), Enum.Font.Gotham, 12, "  " .. name, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 0
Instance.new("UICorner", cb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedChestTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(40, 85, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedChestTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
cb.Activated:Connect(function()
selectedChestTypes[name] = not selectedChestTypes[name] and true or nil
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedChestTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(40, 85, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedChestTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
end)
end
scr.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, lay.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
end
local function updateNPCList()
for _, child in ipairs(scrNPC:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
local npcNames = {}
local allObjects = workspace:GetDescendants()
for i = 1, #allObjects do
local d = allObjects[i]
if d and d:IsA("Humanoid") and d.Parent and d.Parent ~= player.Character and not checkIgnore(d.Parent) then
local cleanName = d.Parent.Name:gsub("%s+", "")
if #cleanName > 0 and cleanName ~= "Model" and cleanName ~= "Part" then
npcNames[d.Parent.Name] = true
end
end
end
for name, _ in pairs(npcNames) do
local cb = Instance.new("TextButton", scrNPC)
cb.Size, cb.Font, cb.TextSize, cb.Text, cb.TextXAlignment, cb.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 32), Enum.Font.Gotham, 12, "  " .. name, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 0
Instance.new("UICorner", cb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedNPCTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(85, 35, 35) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedNPCTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
cb.Activated:Connect(function()
selectedNPCTypes[name] = not selectedNPCTypes[name] and true or nil
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedNPCTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(85, 35, 35) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedNPCTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
end)
end
scrNPC.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layNPC.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
end
local function updateOpenList()
for _, child in ipairs(scrOpen:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end end
local openNames = {}
local bp = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
if bp then
for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
if tool:IsA("Tool") and (string.lower(tool.Name):find("lootbag") or string.lower(tool.Name):find("chest") or string.lower(tool.Name):find("diamond") or string.lower(tool.Name):find("darkness")) then
openNames[tool.Name] = true
end
end
end
for name, _ in pairs(openNames) do
local cb = Instance.new("TextButton", scrOpen)
cb.Size, cb.Font, cb.TextSize, cb.Text, cb.TextXAlignment, cb.BorderSizePixel = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 32), Enum.Font.Gotham, 11, "  " .. name, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, 0
Instance.new("UICorner", cb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedOpenTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(35, 60, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedOpenTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
cb.Activated:Connect(function()
selectedOpenTypes[name] = not selectedOpenTypes[name] and true or nil
cb.BackgroundColor3 = selectedOpenTypes[name] and Color3.fromRGB(35, 60, 85) or Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
cb.TextColor3 = selectedOpenTypes[name] and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(160, 160, 180)
end)
end
scrOpen.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layOpen.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
end
-- Button Logic Connections
toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
chestEnabled = not chestEnabled
toggle.Text = chestEnabled and "Auto Farm: ON" or "Auto Farm: OFF"
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = chestEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(45, 95, 55) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)

killToggle.BackgroundColor3 = npcKillEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(95, 45, 45) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
if npcKillEnabled then task.spawn(npcKillLoop) end
end)
vacuumToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
lootVacuumEnabled = not lootVacuumEnabled
vacuumToggle.Text = lootVacuumEnabled and "Loot Vacuum: ON" or "Loot Vacuum: OFF"
vacuumToggle.BackgroundColor3 = lootVacuumEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(45, 95, 55) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
if lootVacuumEnabled then task.spawn(lootVacuumLoop) end
end)
openToggle.Activated:Connect(function()
autoOpenEnabled = not autoOpenEnabled
openToggle.Text = autoOpenEnabled and "Auto Open: ON" or "Auto Open: OFF"
openToggle.BackgroundColor3 = autoOpenEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(45, 95, 55) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
if autoOpenEnabled then task.spawn(openInventoryLoop) end
end)
refChest.Activated:Connect(function() refChest.Text = "..." updateChestList() task.wait(0.1) refChest.Text = "↻" end)
refNPC.Activated:Connect(function() refNPC.Text = "..." updateNPCList() task.wait(0.1) refNPC.Text = "↻" end)
refOpen.Activated:Connect(function() refOpen.Text = "..." updateOpenList() task.wait(0.1) refOpen.Text = "↻" end)
hide.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false reo.Visible = true end)
reo.Activated:Connect(function() panel.Visible = true reo.Visible = false end)
close.Activated:Connect(function() chestEnabled, npcKillEnabled, autoOpenEnabled, lootVacuumEnabled = false, false, false, false gui:Destroy() end)
-- Initialization
updateChestList()
updateNPCList()
updateOpenList()
-- Smooth Dragging System
local dragging = false
local dragInput, dragStart, startPosition
panel.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = true
dragStart = input.Position
startPosition = panel.Position
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragging = false
end
end)
panel.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
dragInput = input
end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
if dragging and input == dragInput then
local delta = input.Position - dragStart
panel.Position = UDim2.new(
startPosition.X.Scale,
startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
startPosition.Y.Scale,
startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
)
end
end)
